name: ATP Truckers
overview: Artem and Semen are long-distance truck drivers who work for the Rapid transport company. They have completely different personalities and worldviews, but together they travel across Ukraine, where they constantly find themselves in unpredictable situations. Every day, Artem and Semen navigate difficult routes, solving urgent problems and supporting a company that is on the verge of closure. For them, transporting cargo is not just a job, but a series of challenges that shape their character, forcing them to face dangers, intrigues, and their own fears.
